scope: Experimental1213v on 1213u (#46): the NPC combat session follows dynamic relevance - bindings join (newly ready NPC channels, also on an unknown incoming binding) and retire per NPC; per-NPC divergence (nonce/health mismatch, event gap, replay failure, lifecycle) retires only that NPC; a start without NPCs waits; the product controller re-arms a stopped session every 3 s. Take 1248b showed the session dead under the product controller (no_ready_native_actors), so no hit or takedown outcome was shared. Host->client NpcAuthorityMessage::Unconscious (unit-tested): the host reports a natively unconscious NPC and the client knocks its replica out silently (sleep_no_reaction_damage).
